name: Duel Links 2D Arts
author: WillliTo & d02d02
description: Stands a high-resolution, Duel Links style 2D artwork on each face-up monster of the duel field, always facing the camera, with an optional glow. A mod of its own: it does not need 3D Monsters, and it never changes a card's name or text. Turn 3D Monsters off to use it: both draw a monster on the field, and together they would double up.

settings.label: Art size
settings.description: How tall each monster's art stands on the field, in game pixels. Bigger shows more of the detail.

settings.label: Height above the card
settings.description: Raises (or lowers) the art above its card. 0 stands it on the card.

settings.label: Glow
settings.description: A soft pulsing glow around each monster's art.

settings.label: Glow size
settings.description: How far the glow spreads around the art, as a percent of the art's own size.

settings.label: Glow pulse length
settings.description: Frames for one full pulse, dim to bright and back. Lower pulses faster.
